title: Historical RTEC AAP analytical workbook series
process_role: These workbooks are the recurring quantitative workpapers behind RTEC's annual AAP/EEO cycle: workforce/job-group classification, incumbency, external/internal availability weighting, personnel activity, hires, terminations, labor-market inputs, placement-goal comparison and Title VII investigation summaries.
authority_boundary: They are historical analytical evidence, not standalone policy. Current methodology must come from the governing current AAP/EEO plan and current regulatory guidance.
preservation_boundary: Original binaries remain identified by path and SHA-256 in the source archive. The 2022 workbooks have full searchable mirrors in the RTEC HR library; earlier legacy XLS sources are retained as source-identified analytical workpapers and modeled longitudinally. Full cell-level extraction of every legacy XLS is parser-limited in the current non-LibreOffice workflow and is not required to treat them as separate policy documents.

recurring_families.determining_availability: Combines external labor/recruitment-area statistics with internal promotable/transferable/trainable pools and historical placement weights.
recurring_families.incumbency_analysis: Counts incumbents and representation by EEO/job group.
recurring_families.incumbency_to_availability: Compares incumbent representation with calculated availability and records whether placement goals are established.
recurring_families.job_group_analysis: Maps job titles into job groups/EEO categories.
recurring_families.labor_statistics: Stores external demographic/labor-market inputs used by availability analysis.
recurring_families.workforce_analysis: Analyzes workforce composition by department/job title.
recurring_families.title_vii_investigations: Tracks aggregate investigation/complaint/lawsuit status for plan reporting.
